description: Permanently deletes the server with its world, settings, backups and exports, shutting it down if running. Call it only for a server the user named in this request, one server per call; for a request that names none or covers several, such as delete my servers, list them with listServers and ask which to delete first. For a fresh world use resetServer. To keep the world, first startBackupExport and download it with getBackupDownloadUrl. The user can also delete it on the Danger tab of the webUrl from listServers (webUrl followed by danger/). Returns deleted: true.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: deleteServer
title: Delete a server permanently
